products.name: Pinecone
products.note: Vector database; RAG infrastructure; data residency options; enterprise security

profile_text.body:
Pinecone is a company founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York, NY, that develops and operates a fully managed vector database built for AI applications. The company describes its product as enabling similarity search across billions of items in milliseconds, with automatic indexing, instantly searchable writes, and query performance that the company says remains consistent at any scale.

The core product, also called Pinecone, is positioned as infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge-based AI, with features the company lists as including data residency options and enterprise security. It is offered as an API-accessible service, which the company characterizes as representing a next generation of search capability for AI developers.

The held facts note a New York law exposure count of 260 cases, which reflects Pinecone's jurisdiction of record, though no specific litigation is identified in the available data.
